ValidationRule.description: For Type = Group Waiver, SBT - the Description field under the Justification section is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Name=="Service Request", OR(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Group Waivers'), ISPICKVAL(Type,'SBT')), ISBLANK (Description))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter your Justification for the Waiver in the Description field.
